verdict.rationale: Smooth's core interface is natural language. You run tasks with plain-English instructions (e.g. run("Go to google flights and find the cheapest flight...")), you ask Claude Code or other agents to do something on the web and they use Smooth automatically, and data extraction works by describing what you want instead of writing selectors. A hands-on user confirms that a complex prompt worked well. Missing for 10: configuration such as proxies, sessions, profiles and structured-output schemas is set through code or task parameters rather than natural language, and there is only one thin independent report on how reliably prompts are interpreted.
